meta.name: depmap
meta.description: Query the Cancer Dependency Map (DepMap) for cancer cell line gene dependency scores (CRISPR Chronos), drug sensitivity data, and gene effect profiles. Use for identifying cancer-specific vulnerabilities, synthetic lethal interactions, and validating oncology drug targets.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 查询癌症依赖图谱数据，发现肿瘤靶点
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在癌症研究中使用DepMap数据筛选基因依赖或药物敏感性。
copy.tagline_en: Query cancer dependency map data to discover tumor targets.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to analyze cancer gene dependencies or drug sensitivity data from DepMap.

howto.what: Claude 可以查询 DepMap 数据库,获取癌症细胞系的 CRISPR 基因依赖分数、药物敏感性和基因效应数据,并据此分析基因是否对某类癌症必需、寻找合成致死关系或验证药物靶点。
howto.when: 当用户询问某个基因在特定癌症中的必需性、药物敏感性、合成致死关系等时触发。

say.text: 查一下 KRAS 基因在肺癌细胞系中的 CRISPR 依赖分数。
say.note: 会返回各细胞系的 Chronos 分数。

say.text: 分析 BRCA1 突变细胞系中哪些基因更必需。
say.note: 会做合成致死筛选,列出潜在伙伴基因。

say.text: 找出与 EGFR 基因依赖谱最相关的共必需基因。
say.note: 返回相关性最高的基因列表。

howto.what_en: Claude can query DepMap for cancer cell line CRISPR dependency scores, drug sensitivity, and gene effect data, then analyze gene essentiality, synthetic lethality, or drug targets.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks about gene essentiality in specific cancer types, drug sensitivity, synthetic lethality, or biomarker prediction for cancer cell lines.

say_en.text: Query the CRISPR dependency score for KRAS in lung cancer cell lines.
say_en.note: Returns Chronos scores per cell line.

say_en.text: Analyze which genes are more essential in BRCA1-mutant cell lines.
Find genes whose dependency profiles correlate most with EGFR.
